static_traits.name: 陈黛安
static_traits.educational_background: 就读于一所知名的时装设计学院
static_traits.family_status: Moved to New York alone for school
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with classmates are tense due to self-criticism; although a few classmates can communicate, it is hard to openly talk about self-critical thoughts
static_traits.medical_history: 既往史：not yet出现类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理咨询或治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑Good；能具体描述情绪与思维；配合度高、态度积极；但倾向于聚焦负面反馈、negate正面成就

basic_info.main_problem: 即便拿到5个A和1个B，我仍觉得自己是“差Student”，产生without能感与自我批评，这些想法在每次学术评估后都会出现并影响自尊。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are affecting my motivation and passion for fashion design.

special_situations.event: Checks final exam results (5 A's and 1 B)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成绩not是完美（例如not是全A），就说明I am not good enough/是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on negative grades for self-criticism; tries to use rational reminders of own achievements to offset negative thoughts; reduces interaction with classmates to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我是个差Student；一个B就证明I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Received feedback on a design project (overall positive, but color-scheme issues were pointed out)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果某一方面被批评，就说明整体能力not足、我not适合这个领域
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将单点批评视为整体能力缺陷并加倍自我苛责；Social withdrawal以避免进一步的负面评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 连颜色都把握not好，我not该待在这里

special_situations.event: 取得A的成绩或获得积极反馈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 好的结果只是运气，not能说明我真的有能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate与贬低正面成就以防止“自满”，继续强调not足来“督促”自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这只是运气；任何人都能拿到A

special_situations.event: Each time receiving academic assessment (grades or mentor evaluations)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到同学的水平，就not配与他们相处
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps distance from classmates and reduces communication, avoiding being compared and evaluated

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被肯定为“有能力的Student”
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被批评和negate，害怕被视为not够好或not配属于这个领域
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与Social withdrawal来避免外界评价带来的Anxiety与羞耻

object_relations.self_representation: A student who is not good enough and prone to failure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving academic evaluations or criticism (such as negative feedback on color matching)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会把我看作not够好，这些评价证明我not适合该领域
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use稳定而not评判的语气，先Empathy羞耻与Anxiety；再区分事实与推测，邀请具体化证据，并温和地检视“他人在想什么”的依据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师或他人强调其成就与优点时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 理性上知道有成就，但情绪上without法相信或连接，感觉“空洞”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Warm tone, slowed pace; guide the identification of bodily sensations and emotion labels, encourage staying with and experiencing them (rather than only rational analysis), and use specific moments of success to carry out emotion focusing and grounding exercises.

manifestations: Moved to New York alone for school
难以向同学敞开谈论自我批评的想法
When facing one's own achievements, feels 'briefly reassured but quickly hollow'
Hard to experience real value and self-recognition in positive feedback
outcomes: 学习动力与对时装设计的热情下降
对自我能力的怀疑加重

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 与同学互动中感到“not配”，从而Withdrawal
过度关注负面评价、忽视正向反馈

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'must be perfect / get all A's' as the absolute standard for measuring self-worth
把单点批评当作整体negate并内化为自我评价

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 在遭遇批评或比较时，not与他人沟通需求与感受，转为对自己苛责
Social withdrawal、减少与同学交流以避免被评价

exception_events.target_problem: 在收到学术评估时，来访者通常会只关注负面部分（如一个B或批评），迅速产生Self-denial与失败感，随后影响睡眠、饮食与社交。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在那次查看期末成绩的当下，来访者曾短暂为5个A感到开心与自豪，并not yet立即陷入自我批评。
exception_events.reason: not同情境/理解：先注意到多个A并允许自己承认成就；当时灾难化与过滤性思维尚not yet占据全部注意力，因此出现了短暂的积极体验。

positive_force: Has solid professional ability and skills (5 A's among the grades; work evaluated as 'innovative, technically solid')
愿意寻求帮助并参与咨询，态度积极
能在短暂时刻承认与体验自己的成就
negative_force: 设定过高、僵化的标准，将not完美视为失败
心理过滤与过度概括，negate正向反馈
自我批评与Social withdrawal，减少外界支持
学术评估引发的Anxiety与反刍，导致Sleep and diet disturbance

target_behavior.behavior: 过度聚焦负面学术反馈并进行Self-denial（反复自我批评与失败化自我标签）
antecedent: 接收导师/评委的项目反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: 对完美的高标准与非黑即白的评价方式，将单点负面信息泛化为整体not够好
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败感与被negate的可能性，试图通过自我苛责来维持对进步的控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem、学习动力受损；Persistent anxiety与反刍，影响睡眠与饮食

target_behavior.behavior: 与同学的Social withdrawal与回避（减少交流、觉得not配与同学相处）
antecedent: 在成绩或反馈后想到自己“not如同学”
Occasions requiring discussing studies or presenting works with classmates
target_behavior.core_reason: 比较与despair引发的羞耻与Self-doubt，担心被评价或暴露not足
target_behavior.function: 逃避被比较与被负面评价的风险，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、支持减少、Loneliness感上升，进一步削弱自信

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep and diet patterns disturbed (difficulty falling asleep, appetite changes)
antecedent: 收到学术评估后进行反刍与自我批评
在面对即将到来的评价时Anticipation负面结果
target_behavior.core_reason: 持续反刍与Anxiety激活生理唤醒，干扰节律
target_behavior.function: without效的情绪调节尝试（通过反刍试图获得确定感）
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental exhaustion and declining concentration further affect academic performance and interpersonal interaction
